class.name: FellowHeadMotion3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: the head moving with what the face says — a nod on each stressed syllable, a sway that grows while it speaks.
class.description: A modifier of the character's [Skeleton3D] (after the animation's: an [AnimationTree] or [AnimationPlayer] plays under it). It follows a [FellowFaceAnimator] ([member face_animator_path]) and turns the head and neck bones over whatever the animation plays: - a [b]nod[/b] at each of the voice's stressed syllables (each [signal FellowFaceAnimator.emphasized]): the head tipped down by [member nod_degrees] times the syllable's strength, its lowest point [member nod_time] after it, back in about half a second (a critically damped pulse); [method nod] adds one from the game; - a [b]sway[/b]: a slow turn about the three axes (two sines each at frequencies that never repeat together, about [member sway_frequency]), [member idle_sway_degrees] at rest and up to [member speech_sway_degrees] more while the face speaks ([method FellowFaceAnimator.get_speech_activity]). The rotation is in the skeleton's space — the face looks along [member forward], up is +Y — and shared between the neck ([member neck_share]) and the head. With every amount 0 the bones are left as the animation posed them. See [code]docs/decisions/0212-head-motion.md[/code]. [codeblock] # Under the character's Skeleton3D, its face's FellowFaceAnimator elsewhere in the character: var head = FellowHeadMotion3D.new() skeleton.add_child(head) head.face_animator_path = head.get_path_to(face_animator) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_head_angles
method.description: The rotation applied last, in degrees: x the pitch (down), y the yaw (towards the character's left), z the roll.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Diagnostics: [code]frames[/code], [code]usec[/code] (the modifier's own time), [code]nods[/code] (since it was made), [code]nods_active[/code], [code skip-lint]head_bone[/code] and [code skip-lint]neck_bone[/code] (their indices, -1 when not found).

method.name: nod
method.description: Nods once now: [member nod_degrees] times [param strength] (0-2), added to the nods under way.

members.member: The [FellowFaceAnimator] whose stressed syllables the head nods at and whose speech makes it sway more. Without one the head sways at rest (and nods when [method nod] is called).
The direction the face looks in the skeleton's space (Godot's humanoid profile: +Z): a nod tips it down.
The head's bone. Without it in the skeleton nothing is turned (a configuration warning says so).
The sway's amplitude at rest, in degrees.
The neck's bone, sharing the rotation with the head (empty or not found: the head turns alone).
The share of the rotation the neck takes; the head takes the rest.
How far a nod at a full-strength syllable tips the head down, in degrees.
Seconds from a stressed syllable to the nod's lowest point; the head is back in about four times this.
The sway's phases (heads with different seeds sway differently).
The sway's amplitude added while the face speaks at full level, in degrees.
The sway's base frequency, in hertz.
